notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The recent engine update introduced several new bugs. They should all be fixed now, but if you notice any remaining issues, feel free to contact me, and I’ll address them as soon as possible.


Reduced game size from ~10GB to ~6GB

Fixed missing collider on the toy prize in the claw mini-game

Fixed missing lighting in some cutscenes

Updated DLSS and FSR to their latest versions

notes.title: Major Update (1.1)
notes.notes:
Update Notes

Added new dynamic fog and lighting system that changes with the time of day

Updated third-person controller: character walks by default, hold LT / Left Shift to run

Fixed various bugs

Japanese language added to the main branch

More content might be added later

notes.title: Price Drop & Japanese Language Update!
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback, I've decided to drop the base price of HS:KY by over 35%.

I'm also excited to announce that Japanese localization will be available in the next update. I'm always listening to your suggestions, and I'll consider adding more languages in the future based on demand.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259675/4afc31a6e5b45e69baff40e3ff7e1c05af503a3f.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.01: Performance Boost, Save Fix, and More!
notes.notes:
- Enhanced performance: This update improves the overall smoothness and responsiveness of the game.

- Reduced texture footprint: We've optimized textures to decrease file size without compromising visual quality. This can lead to faster loading times and potentially smoother gameplay, especially on lower-end devices.

- Manual save fix: An issue preventing players from saving their progress manually in the pause menu has been addressed. You can now reliably save your game whenever needed.
